2608.01004.title: Who Belongs in the Eval Set? A Capability-Taxonomy-Driven Pipeline for Curating Regression Eval Sets in Agent-Extensibility Platforms
2608.01004.paper_summary: Platform teams hosting agent-extensibility surfaces face a regression-economics paradox: every onboarding customer ships an evaluation set tuned to their domain, but the platform's regression set must live under a hard query-count ceiling bounded by release cadence. To our knowledge, no published industrial pipeline addresses this platform-side curation problem: existing evaluation frameworks are customer-side, and benchmark-compression work treats benchmarks as fixed pools rather than streams of incoming sets. We describe a capability-taxonomy-driven curation pipeline applied to declarative agents with custom actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot. It takes an agent specification and a customer's eval set as input, projects each query into a platform-owned capability taxonomy, and outputs per-query decisions (admit, drop, swap, or human review), under the philosophy that a healthy regression set is the minimal set of queries capturing the maximal spread of capability signatures -- distinct combinations of capabilities a query exercises together. Three components instantiate this: a classifier producing per-(query, capability) verdicts via a hybrid of deterministic specification-based extraction and large-language-model (LLM) semantic inference; an Invocation Quality (IQ) rater scoring how thoroughly a query exercises each capability, so a new query sharing a signature with an existing entry can still be recognized as a better test and displace it; and a consolidator comparing incoming queries against the regression set on coverage and quality through a rule-based decision cascade, backed by a conservative curator that only suggests evictions. The mechanism is taxonomy-agnostic and applies to any regression eval-set curation problem with a typed capability taxonomy, including taxonomies that evolve in response to the very evidence the pipeline surfaces.
2608.01004.paper_summary_zh: 平台團隊在承載代理擴展性介面的過程中面臨著一個回歸經濟學的悖論：每個新客戶都會發送一個針對其領域調整的評估集，但平台的回歸集必須在由發佈節奏所限制的硬查詢計數上限之下運行。據我們所知，沒有已發表的工業管道解決這一平台端的策劃問題：現有的評估框架是客戶端的，而基準壓縮工作將基準視為固定的池，而非不斷進入的集。 我們描述了一個基於能力分類法的策劃管道，應用於 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中具有自定義動作的聲明式代理。它以代理規範和客戶的評估集作為輸入，將每個查詢投影到平台擁有的能力分類法中，並根據每個查詢的決策（接受、丟棄、交換或人工審查）輸出，這一理念是健康的回歸集是捕捉最大能力簽名範圍的最小查詢集——查詢共同運用的能力的不同組合。 三個組件實現了這一點：一個分類器通過基於確定性規範的提取和大型語言模型（LLM）語義推理的混合，生成每個（查詢，能力）的裁決；一個調用質量（IQ）評分者評估查詢對每個能力的充分運用，因此一個與現有條目共享簽名的新查詢仍然可以被識別為更好的測試並取代它；以及一個整合器通過基於規則的決策級聯，將進來的查詢與回歸集在覆蓋範圍和質量上進行比較，並由一個保守的策劃者支持，該策劃者僅建議驅逐。該機制是分類法不可知的，適用於任何具有類型化能力分類法的回歸評估集策劃問題，包括那些根據管道所顯示的證據而演變的分類法。
